title: Gongyi Van-Research Composite Material Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Gongyi Van-Research Composite Material Co., Ltd. is a Henan-based composite materials manufacturer with a significant aerogel product business. Its public site shows a broad aerogel portfolio for batteries, industrial insulation, petrochemical systems, furnaces, buildings, cold chain, and defense-related applications.

Company Overview

The company markets multiple aerogel product families including battery thermal pads, aerogel blankets, ceramic-fiber aerogel felts, pre-oxidized-fiber aerogel felts, and glass-fiber aerogel felts. It positions aerogel as a core product platform within a wider advanced-composites business.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: Mainland China with export-facing presentation and technical application positioning.
  • Focus Areas: Battery thermal protection, petrochemical insulation, industrial furnaces, building insulation, cold-chain and marine insulation, and defense-related applications.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel thermal pads for batteries
  • Aerogel insulation blankets
  • Ceramic-fiber aerogel felt
  • Pre-oxidized-fiber aerogel felt
  • Glass-fiber aerogel felt
